SELECT customer_id, customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE is_active = TRUE
  AND region = 'North';

SELECT order_id
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS net_value
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_home_product_order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.category = 'home'
GROUP BY o.customer_id

SELECT c.region, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.completed_order_count, 0)), 2) AS average_completed_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c2.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
    FROM customers AS c2
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.customer_id = c2.customer_id
     AND o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c2.customer_id
) AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region

SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS net_value
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY net_value DESC, o.customer_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT event_id, vehicle_id
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::numeric >= 100

SELECT v.depot_id, ROUND(AVG(f.liters * f.price_per_liter), 2) AS average_cost
FROM fuel_events AS f
JOIN vehicles AS v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id
GROUP BY v.depot_id
SELECT route_id, ROUND(AVG(distance_km / NULLIF(fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS kilometres_per_litre FROM trips GROUP BY route_id

SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_event_count
FROM vehicles AS v
LEFT JOIN maintenance_events AS m
  ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
 AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 12:00:00'
 AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
GROUP BY v.vehicle_id

SELECT t.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS cargo_trip_count
FROM trips AS t
JOIN vehicles AS v ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id
WHERE v.vehicle_class = 'cargo'
GROUP BY t.driver_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_event_timestamp, t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}' AS documented_engine_temperature
FROM vehicles AS v
JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle_id, event_at, payload,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id ORDER BY event_at DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM telemetry_events
) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
WHERE t.rn = 1
ORDER BY v.vehicle_id;

SELECT r.route_id, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS rounded_efficiency
FROM trips AS t
JOIN routes AS r ON r.route_id = t.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_id
ORDER BY rounded_efficiency DESC, r.route_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(st.ticket_id) FILTER (WHERE st.priority = 'urgent') AS urgent_ticket_count
FROM accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS st ON st.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT t.ticket_id
FROM support_tickets AS t
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT s.plan_id
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE s.account_id = t.account_id
  ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC, s.subscription_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS latest_subscription ON TRUE
JOIN service_plans AS p ON p.plan_id = latest_subscription.plan_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM ticket_events AS e
  WHERE e.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
    AND e.event_type = 'agent_response'
    AND e.event_at > t.opened_at + p.first_response_sla_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND e.event_at = (
      SELECT MIN(e2.event_at)
      FROM ticket_events AS e2
      WHERE e2.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
        AND e2.event_type = 'agent_response'
        AND e2.event_at > t.opened_at
    )
);

SELECT ticket_id, status
FROM support_tickets
WHERE payload ->> 'channel' = 'chat'

WITH account_ticket_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM accounts AS a JOIN support_tickets AS st ON st.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id) SELECT account_id, ticket_count FROM account_ticket_counts WHERE ticket_count > (SELECT AVG(ticket_count) FROM account_ticket_counts)
SELECT account_id FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') UNION SELECT account_id FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'high'
SELECT subscription_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(i.total_due) AS total_paid_invoice_amount
FROM accounts AS a
JOIN invoices AS i ON i.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT account_id, plan_id
FROM (
    SELECT s.account_id, s.plan_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY s.account_id
               ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC, s.subscription_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM subscriptions AS s
) AS ranked
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT s.account_id, SUM(p.monthly_price) AS mrr
FROM subscriptions AS s
JOIN plans AS p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY s.account_id;

SELECT invoice_id
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND due_on < DATE '2026-06-30';

SELECT DISTINCT s.plan_id
FROM subscriptions AS s
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM entitlements AS e
    WHERE e.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
      AND e.enabled = TRUE
  );

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(u.account_id) AS usage_event_count
FROM accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN usage_events AS u
  ON u.account_id = a.account_id
 AND u.units >= 1000
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT w.warehouse_id, COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM warehouses AS w
LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN shipment_items AS si ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id;

SELECT s.carrier_id, COUNT(*) AS late_shipments
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN delivery_events AS d ON d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
WHERE d.payload->>'event_type' = 'delivered'
  AND (d.payload->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz > s.promised_at
GROUP BY s.carrier_id

SELECT p.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM products AS p
JOIN purchase_order_lines AS pol ON pol.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY p.product_id

SELECT si.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.shipment_id) AS shipment_count
FROM shipment_items AS si
GROUP BY si.product_id

SELECT w.warehouse_id
FROM warehouses AS w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory_snapshots AS i
    WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
      AND i.on_hand_qty = 0
);

SELECT w.warehouse_id, COALESCE(s.shipped_qty, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0), 0) AS ratio FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN (SELECT sh.warehouse_id, SUM(si.quantity) AS shipped_qty FROM shipments AS sh JOIN shipment_items AS si ON si.shipment_id = sh.shipment_id GROUP BY sh.warehouse_id) AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.warehouse_id, SUM(rc.received_qty) AS received_qty FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_lines AS pol ON pol.po_id = po.po_id JOIN receipts AS rc ON rc.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id GROUP BY po.warehouse_id) AS r ON r.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id

SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(a.alert_id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'open') AS open_alerts
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN alerts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
SELECT account_id, SUM((payload->>'risk_score')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'risk_score')::numeric >= 70) AS total_transaction_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id

SELECT a.severity, COUNT(i.alert_id)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS investigation_fraction
FROM alerts AS a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT alert_id FROM investigations) AS i ON i.alert_id = a.alert_id
GROUP BY a.severity

SELECT le.device_id
FROM login_events AS le
JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = le.account_id
GROUP BY le.device_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) > 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id, risk_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY customer_id
           ORDER BY assessed_at DESC, assessment_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM risk_assessments
)
SELECT customer_id, risk_score
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id
FROM alerts AS a
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
WHERE a.status = 'open'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM watchlist_matches AS wm
    JOIN customers AS wc ON wc.customer_id = wm.customer_id
    WHERE wm.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND wm.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(wm.customer_id) AS unresolved_watchlist_matches
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN watchlist_matches AS wm
  ON wm.customer_id = c.customer_id
 AND wm.cleared_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(t.amount), 2) AS average_amount
FROM transactions AS t
JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.segment
FROM accounts AS a
JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND s.starts_on <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  AND (s.ends_on IS NULL OR s.ends_on >= DATE '2026-06-30');
